reason: An agent-orchestration plugin that reviews tool steps with an independent model, injects corrective guidance, and optionally warns or blocks matching operations with deterministic rules.

summaries.zh: 通过独立模型审查智能体的工具操作，并将建议注入后续模型调用，同时支持基于规则发出警告或阻止匹配步骤。
summaries.en: Reviews an agent’s tool operations with an independent model, injects guidance into later calls, and supports rule-based warnings or blocking of matching steps.

capabilities: Reviews recent agent tool operations with a separate model
Sends derived session history to a configured model provider
Injects advisory guidance into subsequent model calls
Applies configurable regular-expression warnings or step blocks
